title: Ackee and Saltfish
subtitle: Jamaica's national dish of tinned ackee with salt cod
excerpt: Salt cod, soaked and flaked, fried with tinned ackee, onion, scotch bonnet, and tomatoes. Jamaica's national dish, eaten for breakfast with fried dumplings, breadfruit, or boiled green banana.

recipe.sourceNotes: Ackee and saltfish is the national dish of Jamaica, declared so in the 20th century though both ingredients have deep historical roots. Salt cod (saltfish) was introduced to the Caribbean through the transatlantic trade economy, providing a preserved protein source. Ackee, the fruit of the Blighia sapida tree, was brought from West Africa to Jamaica in the 18th century, possibly by Captain Bligh (of the Bounty) and is now inseparable from Jamaican cooking. Raw or improperly prepared ackee is toxic; tinned ackee available in Caribbean shops is safe and pre-cooked. Only the yellow arils (flesh) are eaten; the red-black seeds and pink membranes are always discarded.

content.text: The salt cod must be soaked for at least 12 hours, ideally overnight, with the water changed two to three times, to reduce the saltiness to an edible level. Taste a small piece after soaking: it should be pleasantly salty but not overwhelming. Simmer briefly, then break it apart gently and pick out any bones and skin carefully. The tinned ackee is already cooked: it goes in at the end and needs only to be warmed through, not cooked further. Stir gently so the ackee does not break up.

items.preparation: soaked in cold water for at least 12 hours, water changed twice, drained

content.text: Put the soaked salt cod in a pan of fresh water. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes until it breaks apart easily. Drain and cool slightly. Break the flesh into large pieces, removing all bones and skin.

Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Fry the onion and red pepper for 5 minutes. Add the spring onion, garlic, scotch bonnet, and thyme. Cook for 2 minutes. Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they soften.

Add the flaked salt cod and stir gently through the vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the drained ackee. Fold in very gently so the ackee does not break up. Heat through for 2 to 3 minutes. Season with black pepper. Taste: it should not need more salt. Serve immediately with fried dumplings, boiled green banana, or festival bread.
